launch.prompt.chat_head: Reply to the message the user typed into the Kander chat box
launch.chat_requires_container_launcher: the chat box needs a launcher that starts the agent in a terminal container such as herdr or tmux; launcher {{.V0}} would take over the board's terminal
tui.chat_placeholder: Type a message for the agent
tui.chat_keys: Enter newline | Ctrl+S send | Esc close (draft kept)
tui.chat_running_keys: Starting the agent; keys are ignored until it finishes
tui.chat_loading_keys: Still resolving the agent; send again in a moment
tui.chat_start_failed: Start failed: {{.V0}}. The message is kept; press Ctrl+S to retry.
tui.chat_focus_failed: Could not switch to the agent: {{.V0}}
tui.chat_no_board: The chat box needs a board; run kander inside a project
